#!name=书旗小说
#!desc=合并了 2 个原模块。原作者及版本见来源记录。
#!format=sgmodule

# 来源 ext-wool-0452 / 书旗小说 / 奶思
# 来源 ext-surge-0123 / 书旗小说去广告 / 可莉🅥[https://github.com/luestr/ProxyResource/blob/main/README.md]

[Rule]
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, ut2.shuqistat.com,REJECT
DOMAIN,render-web.11222.cn,REJECT,extended-matching,pre-matching

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/ut2\.shuqistat\.com\/.+\.gif/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/dsp\.toutiao\.com\/api\/xunfei\/ads\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/sf3-be-pack\.pglstatp-toutiao\.com\/img\/ad\.union\.api/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api-access\.pangolin-sdk-toutiao\.com\/api\/ad\/.+/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/sq\.sljkj\.com\/api\/sdk\/ads2/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/ocean\.shuqireader\.com\/api\/ad\/adserver\/.+/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/ocean\.shuqireader\.com\/api\/route\/iosReadPage\/ad.+/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/.+\.pglstatp-toutiao\.com/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/img-tailor\.11222\.cn\/pm\/app\/.+\.gif/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/img-tailor\.11222\.cn\/cms\/upload\/img\/.+/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/message\.shuqireader\.com\/message\/.+/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/101\.91\.69\.26:8080\/.+/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/feedback\.uc\.cn\/feedback\/api\/get_unread_status/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/.+\.shuqireader\.com\/sapi\/.+/i then reject(404)
^https:\/\/ocean\.shuqireader\.com\/api\/render\/load\/resource - reject

[Script]
移除书城横幅和阅读广告 = type=http-response, pattern=^https:\/\/ocean\.shuqireader\.com\/sqios\/render\/render\/page\/bookstore$, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/ShuQiCenterReader/ShuQiCenterReader_remove_ads.js, requires-body=true

[Map Local]
^https:\/\/huichuan\.sm\.cn\/nativead data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/ocean\.shuqireader\.com\/api\/route\/iosReadPage\/adV2 data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/ocean\.shuqireader\.com\/api\/route\/ios\/readPage$ data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% ut2.shuqistat.com, dsp.toutiao.com, sf3-be-pack.pglstatp-toutiao.com, api-access.pangolin-sdk-toutiao.com, sq.sljkj.com, ocean.shuqireader.com, img-tailor.11222.cn, message.shuqireader.com, feedback.uc.cn, *.shuqireader.com, 101.91.69.26, huichuan.sm.cn
